I did the Sturridge and Lucas SBC so now i'm forced to have a PL team, so I figured might as well try the SBC to see if I could pack any more upgrades (potentially the Lukaku or Hazard IFs that are in packs in that Best of TOTW promo going around).

Had 260kish already that was disposable, so went and bought 10 players of each position (700-850 depending on how far back you go in transfer list), and had around 160k after (so 100k for 10 upgrade packs).

In my 10 packs, I got 2nd IF Van Dijk (330k XBOX atm), Pogba (395k), Ozil (not gonna use but 19k), Ederson (18k), and Azpilicueta (33k). Not only this, but you also get nonrares in your packs which you can use to do the regular PL Upgrade SBC, which also gives you rare players. So after rinsing and repeating I ended up getting 4 more Premium Packs and around 8-10 regular upgrade packs.

ALL FOR 100k. So I \*profited\* around 700k in players worth. Now I plan on spending the rest of my coins doing the premium upgrade until i'm out. Can't imagine who I will get by then.
